standard-dialogue-normal-variant.player: How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?

standard-dialogue-normal-variant.npc: Approximately 32,768 depending on his woodcutting level.

standard-dialogue-oak-variant.npc: What did the oak tree drop?

standard-dialogue-maple-variant.npc: Why do maple trees not try to explore new lands?

standard-dialogue-teak-variant.npc: Can we teak a break? My legs are tired.

standard-dialogue-mahogany-variant.npc: If you had a pet pig, you could call it ma-hog-eat-any.

standard-dialogue-arctic-pine-variant.npc: Is there anything I can't eat?

standard-dialogue-yew-variant.player: Yew are too kind, my furry little friend.

standard-dialogue-magic-variant.player: Anything I can do to cheer you up?

standard-dialogue-magic-variant.npc: A dam and some logs could be some fun....

standard-dialogue-redwood-variant.npc: It sure is hard to cut the top off of a redwood tree... You can't take any short cuts!

standard-dialogue-redwood-variant.player: Why do I even try talking to you.

standard-dialogue-camphor-variant.npc: I almost choked on a log! I don't know if I camphor-give you for that!

standard-dialogue-jatoba-variant.npc: Everyone always asks why, what and when but never how. I'm jatoba-whelmed with all of this!

standard-dialogue-rosewood-variant.npc: Eating logs is like enjoying wine. They all have a nuance of flavour. That last one for example was earthy, with hints of nuts and redberries, along with a scent of rose.

standard-dialogue-larch-variant-sailing-.npc: I almost choked on a log! This is not a larching matter!

standard-dialogue-cedar-variant-sailing-.npc: After I've eaten the ce-dar it will be called ce-where.

steps.speaker: Fox
steps.text: ...maybe if we all made an underground village together...

steps.player: What are you pondering, my furry friend?

steps.speaker: Fox
steps.text: Oh, just a grand plan to save all the wildlife from being hunted.

steps.player: Hello fox, what do you say?

steps.speaker: Fox
steps.text: I do wish people would stop asking me that!

steps.speaker: Fox
steps.text: I'm famished! Do you have any food?

steps.player: I'm sure we could find you something.

steps.speaker: Fox
steps.text: How about we visit a chicken coop to, uh, admire the scenery!

steps.player: I better find you something to eat quickly.

standard-dialogue-fox-form-when-using-a-.speaker: Fox
standard-dialogue-fox-form-when-using-a-.text: Ooh, don't mind if I do!
You feed the chicken to your fox.

standard-dialogue-fox-form-when-using-ot.speaker: Fox
standard-dialogue-fox-form-when-using-ot.text: While I appreciate the offer, I won't eat any old thing!

steps.speaker: Pheasant
steps.text: I can't believe people try to eat us.

steps.player: What would you taste like? Chicken?

steps.speaker: Pheasant
steps.text: I'd taste fowl, you wouldn't like it at all...

steps.speaker: Pheasant
steps.text: You mean the odd fellow who recruits random adventurers to butcher an exorbitant amount of my kind daily in exchange for his spare clothing?

steps.speaker: Pheasant
steps.text: Why yes, he's simply delightful...

steps.player: You look a bit on edge. Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Pheasant
steps.text: I have the strangest urge to run infront of a fast moving adventurer...

standard-dialogue-pheasant-form-when-usi.text: You feed the berries to your pheasant.

standard-dialogue-pheasant-form-when-usi.speaker: Pheasant
standard-dialogue-pheasant-form-when-usi.text: Bwak! I am not some common fowl that will eat anything, I have standards!

using-unusable-logs-on-it-any-coloured-l.npc: Eww! What is that spell? Why would I want to chew on that? It stinks!

using-unusable-logs-on-it-any-pyre-logs.npc: What's this strange coating on the log?

using-unusable-logs-on-it-any-pyre-logs.player: Olive oil blessed at an alter deep in Morytania. The oil helps with burning the shades in the area.

using-unusable-logs-on-it-any-pyre-logs.npc: ...and you want me to chew on it?
That's a hard pass from me.

using-unusable-logs-on-it-achey-tree-log.npc: There's something not quite right about this log.
I'm not sure, it looks like it's in pain, maybe a little... achey?

using-unusable-logs-on-it-blisterwood-lo.npc: sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These may look like logs but they stink of iron, what do I look like a rock golem?

using-unusable-logs-on-it-juniper-logs.npc: sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These logs smell just a bit too botanical for my liking. More of a beer beaver myself.

when-using-the-funky-shaped-log-when-use.npc: Wow, that was awesome! You've really opened my eyes to the different types of logs out there in the world. I'll happily take any others you have!

when-using-the-funky-shaped-log-when-use.text: Your pet Beaver may enjoy this more.

when-using-the-funky-shaped-log-when-use.prompt: Change your pet back into a Beaver?

steps.prompt: Give your pet Beaver a Funky shaped log to unlock its ability to transform?

options.text: Yes, I'd like to treat my beaver.

steps.text: In a remarkable display, your pet Beaver consumes the Funky shaped log.

steps.npc: Wow, that was awesome! You've really opened my eyes to the different types of logs out there in the world. I'll happily take any others you have!

options.text: No, it's fine as it is.

when-using-the-golden-pheasant-egg.text: You feed the egg to your pet...

metamorphosis-option.text: If only one other form is unlocked:
If no other forms have been unlocked, and funky shaped log has not been given:

steps.text: You can unlock the ability for your pet Beaver to change colour by feeding it a Funky shaped log.

metamorphosis-option.text: If no other forms have been unlocked, and funky shaped log has been given:

steps.text: You can change the colour of your pet Beaver by feeding it different types of logs.
You can unlock other forms for your pet Beaver by finding special items during Woodcutting events.

metamorphosis-option.prompt: Select a new form for your pet Beaver.

steps.text: If the pet is already a beaver:
Your pet is already a Beaver.
If the pet is already a fox:
Your pet is already a Fox.
If the pet is already a pheasant:
Your pet is already a Pheasant.
